title_sq: Apartament 2+1 ne shitje Ish Parku Autobuzave ne Tirane
description_sq:
Rruga Ylbere Bylykbashi, shitet apartament 2+1 me siperfaqe 75m2 kati i 3 i nje pallati egzistues parafabrikat. Organizohet nga korridor shperndares, soxhorno, 2 dhoma gjumi, tualeti dhe ballkon. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i restauruar nga e para,me shtrese termoizolimi te brendshme, te gjitha dritaret plastike me xhama triplex, parket, rifinitura te mureve, rinovuar rrjeti elektrik dhe hidraulik.
Shitet 16500000 Leke!
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale, Former Bus Park in Tirana
description_en: Rruga Ylbere Bylykbashi, 2+1 apartment for sale with a surface area of ​​75m2, 3rd floor of an existing prefabricated building. It is organized by distribution corridor, living room, 2 bedrooms, toilet and balcony. The apartment has been completely restored from scratch, with internal thermal insulation layer, all plastic windows with triplex glass, parquet, refinished walls, renewed electrical and plumbing network. For sale 16500000 Lek!
